memos.scout:
There is no honest case for buying PPAD now.

Demand is not holding. In the last 15 minutes, sellers (114) outnumbered buyers (59), sell SOL ran at 101.56 against 39.34 bought, and net flow was -62.22 SOL. The price is down 74% over that window and 89% off its 30-minute high. A coin in that state has no visible bid to carry it another 30-60 minutes.

The launch structure is also bad. Bundled buyers hold 88.8% of the curve, and the top 3 wallets hold 25% of supply. Post-graduation, the first two minutes saw sells at 0.82 of buys, and a launch bot was present. The 421.7 SOL of early buying looks more like coordinated entry than organic interest, and the coordinated holders are now exiting.

The one positive is that the coin is alive, has 43 buyers, and wasn't an airdrop factory. Those don't outweigh a collapsing flow, heavy bundling, and a pool of only 65 SOL, where a $20 round trip would also eat a large slice of price impact.

Recommendation: skip. A skipped coin costs nothing, and this one shows the pattern of a dump in progress.
